movie_title: Are you excited about the World Cup? 6 Minute English
introduction: Improve your English vocabulary and speaking with 6 Minute English! The 2018 World Cup is about to k

vocabulary.definition: to be completely focused or absorbed by something
vocabulary.example: During the World Cup, I will be glued to the TV watching all the matches.

vocabulary.definition: the team or person least likely to win
vocabulary.example: I always root for the underdogs in sports competitions because their victories are inspirational.

vocabulary.definition: fair and honest behavior, especially in a sporting context
vocabulary.example: His display of sportsmanship, even in defeat, earned him respect from fans worldwide.

vocabulary.definition: related to big companies or business organizations
vocabulary.example: The football tournament has become more corporate over the years, with sponsors influencing many aspects of the event.

vocabulary.definition: lots of talking and publicity to generate interest in something
vocabulary.example: The marketing team created a lot of hype around the new product launch to attract customers.

vocabulary.definition: to believe or consider likely to succeed
vocabulary.example: She fancies her chances of winning the competition after months of rigorous training.
